title: Release Control
description: Output record for the `devai release gate`, `devai release postdeploy verify`, and `devai release runtime drift` commands (Phase 11.B / D-39). Records a deploy-gate decision and the inputs that drove it; persisted under .devai/state/releases/REL-<id>.json so the audit trail can be replayed.

id.description: Stable id, monotonically allocated from the REL counter.

kind.description: Which release verb produced the record.

artifact_ref.description: Optional immutable artifact identifier (digest, tag, container image, etc.) the gate decision applies to.

environment.description: Target environment for the gate decision.

verdict.description: Final gate decision. block = deploy not permitted; review = human attention required; inconclusive = inputs insufficient; pass = OK to proceed.

reasons.description: Plain-language reasons backing the verdict. Empty when verdict=pass.

scorecard_ref.description: Path to the scorecard JSON consumed (or null when none provided).

audit_chain_head.description: SHA-256 of the audit chain head at the moment of the gate.

artifact_chain_head.description: Claimed chain head baked into the artifact (set by `release postdeploy-verify`).

checks.description: Individual gate-component checks that contributed to the verdict.

rollback_recommended.description: Set by postdeploy-verify / runtime-drift when the deployed runtime diverges from the artifact-of-record.
